description: This file defines a DialogFragment subclass that displays a rating dialog with options like like, love, dislike, and close. It interacts with a ViewModel to handle user actions and fetches data from various repositories.

classes.name: RatingDialogFragment
classes.description: A DialogFragment that presents a rating interface with options like like, love, dislike, and close, and handles user interactions by invoking corresponding ViewModel actions.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the dialog view, sets up UI elements and their click behaviors, and handles back key press to dismiss the dialog.

methods.description: Factory method to create a new instance of RatingDialogFragment with a specified groupId argument.
